cell_effects_withheld.row: Members Mark Peanut Oil, 35 lbs. | $55.96 | size 799.429 fl oz
cell_effects_withheld.why_withheld: the size is NOT a shelf fact: qty_basis package-qty-derived-lp/up back-computes 55.96 divided by Sams ROUNDED unit price $0.07/foz = 799.43 fl oz, while the title's own 35 lbs is about 586 fl oz at peanut-oil density (which would be about $0.0955/floz). A 2-decimal rounded unit price amplifies into a large size error at this magnitude, and here it disagrees with the printed weight by about 36%. Withhold via known-wrong (key peanut-oil|Sams|members-mark-peanut-oil-35-lbs, reason recorded) rather than fabricating a density-derived size. Result: peanut-oil crown = Walmart 0.1223.
